literal_meaning: গলা ভাঙা (throat breaking or voice breaking)
figurative_meaning_en: Temporary distortion or hoarseness of the voice
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঠাণ্ডা লেগে তার গলা ভেঙে গেছে।
অনেক গান গেয়ে গলাটা ভেঙে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: He caught a cold and his voice became hoarse.
After singing too much, her voice broke.
note: Commonly used to describe temporary voice issues due to cold or overuse.
